domain: Autonomous Crawler Cleaning Robot for Rooftop Commercial Solar Arrays
authorized_title: How can an autonomous crawler cleaning robot simulated in MuJoCo recover soiling-induced energy losses (15-18% monthly) on inclined commercial rooftop solar arrays while reducing cleaning cycle operational expenditure compared to manual labor?
